blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `findSalesChannelStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step either retrieves a sales channel either using the ID provided as an input, or, if no ID
is provided, the default sales channel of the first store.

children.name: FindSalesChannelStepInput
children.description: The details of the sales channel to find.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the sales channel.

children.name: name
children.description: The name of the sales channel.

children.name: description
children.description: The description of the sales channel.

children.name: is_disabled
children.description: Whether the sales channel is disabled.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Holds custom data in key-value pairs.

children.name: locations
children.description: The locations of the sales channel.
